title: My, how time flew! Cant believe we only have 2 shows left. #thepajama...
transcript: Come to the Pajama Factory with me. It's the final weekend of the Pajama Game at Summerplace Theater in Naperville, Illinois. After a full day at work, come to the theater around 6 o'clock. It's our entrance way. And look at Gianna and Katie rehearsing. Steam Heat fit check. I play Vernon Hines, the Time Study Man. There's my watch. Time to get ready. Now the first thing is to change out this watch for my show. Watch Tempest Fugit. Gotta get those mic packs. I am number 3. I finally figured out how to tape my microphone on my head so it doesn't fall off in the middle of the show. And then we have to do a sound check. There's Steve Belt. Not a classic. We're performing at Naperville Central High School, the largest venue I've ever done a show in. It's pretty cool. A little sneaky behind the scenes. I love this number so much. There's Taylor as Gladys, giving us little Elaine switch at Liberty. And the lovely cast. Look at these lovely faces at the interval. Get ready for some see me. And then there's Paige, who plays Mabel. I have such a fun time. They're so cute. And then some people came to visit. Group photo. Come see us! Final weekend, Neighborville, Illinois.
